Why It Matters: Client is active early and likely to stay on track.
Recommended Action: Continue normal encouragement and reinforce the first small win.
Example Message: Amazing start — keep this momentum going. Send me one quick update today so I can guide you better.

Why It Matters: Client is still inside the safe engagement window.
Recommended Action: Send a light reminder and make the first check-in feel easy.
Example Message: Just checking in — send me one small update today, even if it is not perfect. We will adjust from there.

Why It Matters: This is the intervention deadline because churn risk rises sharply after Day 3.
Recommended Action: Send a personal accountability message, ask what is blocking them, and offer a simple 10-minute restart task.
Example Message: Hey, I noticed you have not checked in yet. No pressure, but I do not want you to feel stuck alone. What is the main thing blocking you right now? Reply with just one word: time, food, workout, or motivation.

Why It Matters: This group already shows much higher churn and lower goal achievement.
Recommended Action: Send a stronger reset message with social proof, progress examples, and a quick call/check-in option.
Example Message: I know starting can feel hard, but you do not need a perfect restart. I can give you a simple 10-minute plan for today. Also, I want to show you how another client restarted after struggling and still made progress.

Why It Matters: Never-engaged clients had 100% churn in the dataset.
Recommended Action: Send one final supportive message, ask if they want to pause or restart, and mark them for win-back follow-up.
Example Message: I have not heard from you, so I will pause active follow-up for now. If you want to restart, reply with RESET and I will help you begin again with one small step.
